ref: ADR-0025 "Data errors name their box" (Q10): a box parameter that is a number follows the xs:decimal rule of the statistic family (#75), and a position is an xs:nonNegativeInteger; anything else is err:FORG0001 at the box, checked whatever the data (#79)
note: copyValue{position=-1}: the position is no xs:nonNegativeInteger, so copyValue raises err:FORG0001 at its box F1 before it reads Sku.
